The *Kusalattika, Vipākattika* (Patthana 11.2) is an Abhidhamma text belonging to the Paṭṭhāna section of the Pali Tipiṭaka [SuttaCentral]. Like other analytical treatises in the Paṭṭhāna, it investigates conditional relations by combining categorical matrices, specifically the triad of wholesome states (*kusalattika*) and the triad of resultant states (*vipākattika*) [SuttaCentral].

No curated parallels in other Buddhist traditions or languages are registered by SuttaCentral [SuttaCentral].
